clauses.text: In Corvane, every vehicle on a public road must carry liability insurance with at least these limits: $25,000 for bodily injury to one person, $50,000 for all bodily injury in one accident and $20,000 for property damage.
An insurer that decides to cancel a policy must notify the policyholder at least 20 days in advance. When the reason is unpaid premium, 10 days' notice is enough.
Anyone who has an accident or a loss must report it to their insurer within 60 days, unless they show they could not do so sooner.
Drivers must carry current proof of insurance, on paper or in digital form, and show it when a traffic officer asks.
A lawsuit against an insurer over an auto policy must be filed within two years of the accident or loss.
